title: Unexpectedly great
body: Somehow, this app is really good. I didn’t expect much from it when I first downloaded it, thinking to myself that I’m probably gonna forget about it after 3, maybe 4 days of using it. But something about the quests system and the ability to buy your birb new clothes and furnitures for their house is motivating enough for me to actually get on with the tasks. I don’t forget to open and check the app, because my mind treats it as a game, so I open it in my free time. And so I see all the tasks I’ve yet to complete. Another thing is that despite the app having premium option, I never feel like I’m missing out on a lot without it (at least I haven’t so far) which is great. I highly recommend the app.
author: never00__

title: A game changer
body: This is the kind of app that can actually transform your life. I’ve been using it for about 6 months now, and during that time, I have seen huge improvement in consistency with the things I wanted to be doing regularly. There is a lot of toxic stuff out there that is supposed to kick your butt into productivity, and that is a hard pass for me. However, this app is meant to provide positive encouragement, and give you a sense of accomplishment and not being alone (the social aspect is great and helps keep the habits going even more!). I encourage everyone struggling with self-care and keeping consistent to give Finch a try.
